description: Forwards session lifecycle and tool events to the Cupola daemon (npx cupola) running on localhost:7777. Fires on every event listed below, for every tool -- no matcher, since hook.sh's own job is just to report which pid/tmux-pane is doing something right now, not to filter or block anything. Mirrors install-hooks.js's EVENTS list and per-event shape exactly, so a settings.json-based install and this plugin register functionally identical hooks.
